test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 24 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: The salary, allowances and pension of the Comptroller and Auditor General of India is charged upon ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Consolidated Fund of India**__ .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Consolidated Fund of India:**

 
 
• The salary, allowances, and pension of the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India are charged upon the Consolidated Fund of India.
 
• This means that these expenses are paid directly from this fund without requiring a vote in Parliament.
 
• The Consolidated Fund of India is the primary fund of the Indian government, where all revenues are deposited.
 
• It includes all revenues received by the government, loans raised, and repayments of loans.
 
• This ensures the independence of the CAG by securing their remuneration.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Public Account:**

 
 
• The Public Account of India holds funds that do not belong to the government but are held in trust.
 
• Examples include provident fund deposits, small savings collections, and other earmarked funds.
 
• These funds do not form part of the Consolidated Fund of India.
 
• Payments from the Public Account can be made without parliamentary approval in certain cases.
 
• It is where money is held, that the government is just holding in trust.
 
 
 
• **Consolidated Fund of State:**
 
 
• The Consolidated Fund of State is the equivalent of the Consolidated Fund of India at the state level.
 
• It holds the revenues of the state government.
 
• It is used to pay the salaries and expenses of state government officials.
 
• The CAG's salary is a central government expense, not a state expense.
 
• Therefore the CAG's salary is not charged to this fund.
 
 
 
• **Contingency Fund of India:**
 
 
• The Contingency Fund of India is used to meet unforeseen or urgent expenditures.
 
• It is placed at the disposal of the President of India.
 
• It is used for emergencies, and unexpected expenses.
 
• It is not used for the regular salaries and pensions of constitutional authorities like the CAG.
 
• It is a relatively small fund, when compared to the consolidated fund of India.
